Mission Local reported in 2011 on a proposed residential-permit parking zone near Dolores Park—not on turning the park itself into a paid parking lot. The notice said a City Hall hearing would consider two-hour parking limits on parts of 20th and Dolores streets, Monday through Friday, with permits for residents. A concerned reader objected that some apartment residents depended on street parking but could not qualify for the permits.
